title: Great MC
description: Hello traveler, are you ready to embark on an epic, never-ending adventure? If so, you've come to the right place.
body:
![GMC](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/057bd1f89d86abc948050631f910fb5e5a4797fc.png)****This is not a typical modpack****
> It’s a full-scale adventure pack for Minecraft 1.20.1, designed for players who want a massive world, hundreds of structures, challenging bosses, and smooth performance even on weaker PCs.

> **The modpack combines the best exploration and structure mods**

> **Combat and progression are greatly enhanced**

> **Performance is boosted with a full optimization suite**

> **Perfect for players who want to:**

 explore a huge, diverse world

  fight challenging bosses

  discover dungeons, ruins, temples, and hidden locations

  play solo or multiplayer

  enjoy beautiful visuals with high FPS

  
> **Some mods:**
1. Terralith
2. Regions Unexplored
3. Biomes O’ Plenty
4. Oh The Biomes You’ll Go (BYG)
5. YUNG’s Better Structures (All mods)
6. Structory
7. Moog’s Structures
8. Dungeons Arise
9. Aether
10. Twilight Forest
11. Better Combat
12. Bosses of Mass Destruction
13. Aquamirae
14. Ultris
15. Ultimate Bosses
16. Naturalist
17. Hybrid Aquatic
18. Better end/nether
19. Sodium
20. ModernFix

> **_I hope you will find some paradise out there_**
